title: Rams game at SoFi Stadium costs families $422 more than Chargers game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams game at SoFi Stadium costs families $422 more than Chargers game
sources.description: A family of four will spend about $1,627.71 to attend a Rams game at SoFi Stadium in 2026—$421.88 more than a Chargers game.
